1 of the29 original holdouts without a Top gained one. Missing interests and responsibilities remain unknown. Original profiles and live flow are unchanged.

The narrow fix exposes existing non-introductory activity contexts when two profession-specific interests are confirmed but a second activity context is missing. It preserves near-complete earlier profession-specific checks. The creative-feedback binding requires explicit writing-revision or visual-message/user-observation facts; spatial design alone does not qualify.

A broader pool and broader rescue priority were rejected because they displaced useful questions. These are inspected research splits, not unseen validation.
